
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/artech/p/20208525/agent-pipeline-04" title="发布于 2026-05-29 08:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">[MAF的Agent管道详解-04]如何让LLM按照要求的结构输出数据?</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        针对`IChatClient`的结构化输出可以通过调用如下这些重载的`GetResponseAsync
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>针对<code>IChatClient</code>的结构化输出可以通过调用如下这些重载的<code>GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;</code>扩展方法来完成。具体的实现很简单，这些方法最终会利用指定或者默认的<code>JsonSerializerOptions</code>针对泛型参数T生成一个<code>ChatResponseFormatJson</code>对象，并作为<code>ChatOptions</code>的<code>ResponseFormat</code>属性。这个<code>ResponseFormat</code>承载的JSON Schema将提供给LLM指导它按照定义的格式生成输出内容。当<code>IChatClient</code>接收到LLM的响应结果时，利用匹配的<code>JsonSerializerOptions</code>对响应结果进行反序列化后，封装成一个<code>ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;</code>对象返回给调用方。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static class ChatClientStructuredOutputExtensions
{
    public static Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        IEnumerable&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages, 
        ChatOptions? options = null, bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
    public static Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        string chatMessage, 
        ChatOptions? options = null, 
        bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
    public static Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        ChatMessage chatMessage, 
        ChatOptions? options = null,
        bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
    public static Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        string chatMessage, 
        JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions, 
        ChatOptions? options = null, 
        bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
    public static Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        ChatMessage chatMessage, 
        JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions, 
        ChatOptions? options = null, 
        bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
    public static async Task&lt;ChatResponse&lt;T&gt;&gt; GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;(
        this IChatClient chatClient, 
        IEnumerable&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages, 
        JsonSerializerOptions serializerOptions, 
        ChatOptions? options = null, 
        bool? useJsonSchemaResponseFormat = null, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default(CancellationToken));
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="1-调用getresponseasync方法获取结构化输出">1. 调用GetResponseAsync<t>方法获取结构化输出</t></h2>
<p>在如下的演示程序中，我们定义了一个描述个人基本信息的<code>Profile</code>类。我们利用<code>OpenAIClient</code>创建了一个<code>IChatClient</code>对象，并调用了<code>GetResponseAsync&lt;Profile&gt;</code>方法来从指定的一段文本中提取个人信息。在得到作为响应的<code>Response&lt;Profile&gt;</code>对象后，利用<code>Result</code>属性提取反序列化响应内容生成的<code>Profile</code>对象，调试断言表明这个<code>Profile</code>对象与我们预设的<code>Profile</code>对象是相等的。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using dotenv.net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using OpenAI;
using System.ClientModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.Json;

DotEnv.Load();
var model = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("MODEL")!;
var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY")!;
var openAIUrl = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENAI_URL")!;
var openAIClient = new OpenAIClient(
    credential: new ApiKeyCredential(key: apiKey),
    options: new OpenAIClientOptions
    {
        Endpoint = new Uri(openAIUrl)
    });

var chatClient = openAIClient.GetResponsesClient().AsIChatClient(defaultModelId: model);
var profile = new Profile { Name = "张三" , Gender = Gender.Male, Age = 26 };
var prompt = "从下面内容中提取有效的个人信息：我叫张三，男，今年26岁";
var response1 = await chatClient.GetResponseAsync&lt;Profile&gt;(chatMessage: prompt);
Debug.Assert(profile == response1.Result);

public enum Gender
{
    Male,
    Female,
}
class Profile:IEquatable&lt;Profile&gt;
{
    public string? Name { get; set; }
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }
    public int Age { get; set; }
    public bool Equals(Profile? other)
    { 
        if(other is null) return false;
        return Name == other.Name &amp;&amp; Gender == other.Gender &amp;&amp; Age == other.Age;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>对于程序涉及的LLM调用，如下的两段JSON为发送的请求和接收的响应。可以看出针对<code>Profile</code>类型的JSON Schema被包含在发送给LLM的请求中，而LLM生成的响应内容则被成功地反序列化成了一个<code>Profile</code>对象。</p>
<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "model": "gpt-5.2-chat",
  "text": {
    "format": {
      "type": "json_schema",
      "name": "Profile",
      "schema": {
        "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "gender": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [
              "Male",
              "Female"
            ]
          },
          "age": {
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "required": [
          "name",
          "gender",
          "age"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "input": [
    {
      "type": "message",
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "从下面内容中提取有效的个人信息：我叫张三，男，今年26岁"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-json">{

<h2 id="2-通过设置chatoptions的responseformat属性来获取结构化输出">2. 通过设置ChatOptions的ResponseFormat属性来获取结构化输出</h2>
<p><code>GetResponseAsync&lt;T&gt;</code>方法最终会利用指定或者默认的<code>JsonSerializerOptions</code>针对泛型参数T生成一个<code>ChatResponseFormatJson</code>对象，并作为<code>ChatOptions</code>的<code>ResponseFormat</code>属性。当我们直接调用<code>GetResponseAsync</code>方法时，<code>ChatOptions</code>的<code>ResponseFormat</code>属性返回的JSON Schema将作为调用LLM提示词的一部分，用于指导LLM生成符合结构的输出。上面的演示程序与下面这段其实是完全等效的。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using dotenv.net;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using OpenAI;
using System.ClientModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Text.Json;

DotEnv.Load();
var model = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("MODEL")!;
var apiKey = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("API_KEY")!;
var openAIUrl = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENAI_URL")!;
var openAIClient = new OpenAIClient(
    credential: new ApiKeyCredential(key: apiKey),
    options: new OpenAIClientOptions
    {
        Endpoint = new Uri(openAIUrl)
    });

var chatClient = openAIClient.GetResponsesClient().AsIChatClient(defaultModelId: model);
var options = new ChatOptions
{
    ResponseFormat = ChatResponseFormat.ForJsonSchema&lt;Profile&gt;()
};
var response = await chatClient.GetResponseAsync(chatMessage: prompt, options: options);
var profile2 = JsonSerializer.Deserialize&lt;Profile&gt;(response1.Messages.Last().Text, AIJsonUtilities.DefaultOptions);
Debug.Assert(profile == new Profile { Name = "张三", Gender = Gender.Male, Age = 26 });

public enum Gender
{
    Male,
    Female,
}
class Profile:IEquatable&lt;Profile&gt;
{
    public string? Name { get; set; }
    public Gender Gender { get; set; }
    public int Age { get; set; }
    public bool Equals(Profile? other)
    { 
        if(other is null) return false;
        return Name == other.Name &amp;&amp; Gender == other.Gender &amp;&amp; Age == other.Age;
    }
}
</code></pre>
